An unidentified [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' possessed [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]], which were used to pull [[Starship/Legends|starships]] out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The [[Vagaari Empire]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the projectors from the species and incorporated them into the [[Vagaari slaver fleet]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
